clips.title: The story
paras: The Ghost Hair Comb is an eerie grooming tool entangled with the spectral strands of the spirit Blind Mary. Sent to the ghost by Madame Eva, the comb becomes an instrument of tragic realization before its gathered hair is spun into uncanny thread.

Madame Eva of Darkshire sends the comb to the haunted spirit Blind Mary, who resides in a lonely dilapidated dwelling on the outskirts of Duskwood. When presented with the comb, the ghost recoils in sheer horror, suddenly confronted with the harrowing reality that she is no longer the lovely living woman she once was. In her grief and distress, Mary thrusts the comb away, leaving it tangled with strands of her own ghostly hair.
